description: Declarative bidirectional mapping between RainMaker Neo standard capabilities and Matter clusters/attributes. Consumed by the firmware Matter mirror (lowering) and, in future, by raising engines (apps/bridges). See docs/spec/common_data_model_draft.md section 4. A capability's matter_match is the Matter location it maps to, carrying its own value_type: how a value is wrapped on the Matter side is declared here, not inferred. A match with node_scoped lives on the root endpoint. Composites keep a single matter_match object: one cluster with N derived attributes.

write_as.note: Desired state, so On/Off selected by value - Toggle (0x02) is not idempotent

startup.note: StartUpOnOff: 0/1 assert Off/On at boot, 2 toggles the previous state. Skipped after an OTA restart, matching CHIP's own policy (a software update is not a power cycle).
StartUpCurrentLevel: 0 means the minimum level per spec, and the mirror's LevelControl minimum is 1.

defaults.bounds_note: raising fallback when the device exposes no bounds attribute; lowering ignores it

startup.note: StartUpCurrentLevel: 0 means the minimum level per spec, and the mirror's LevelControl minimum is 1.

capabilities.note: The dim level of a switch or load control, as esp.param.brightness is of a light: the same LevelControl mapping under the param name the switch device types use. rule_gated, so it lowers only for the rules that name it and a light keeps brightness as its name for the attribute.

defaults.bounds_note: raising fallback when the device exposes no bounds attribute; lowering ignores it

bounds_from.note: min/max are the param's bounds and each names the attribute it lands on. kelvin_mireds is decreasing, so the kelvin min lands on 0x400C ColorTempPhysicalMaxMireds and the kelvin max on 0x400B ColorTempPhysicalMinMireds

startup.note: StartUpColorTemperatureMireds: the stored mireds value is asserted as-is at boot.

defaults.bounds_note: raising fallback when the device exposes no bounds attribute; lowering ignores it

seed_as.note: CHIP keeps CurrentHue/CurrentSaturation in transition-state structs that only a Move/Step command initialises, while its HSV tick writes both attributes from both states: the first MoveToHue since boot would assert a saturation of 0 over the seeded one. StopMoveStep is the only command that re-reads both from the attribute store without writing either - every Move/Step alternative schedules the tick - so it is declared on both HS capabilities and sent once per (endpoint, cluster, command).

capabilities.note: rule_gated: lowers only for device rules that list it - keeps ColorControl off device types (e.g. 0x0101 Dimmable Light) whose Matter definition forbids it.

defaults.bounds_note: raising fallback when the device exposes no bounds attribute; lowering ignores it

seed_as.note: Same shadow as esp.param.hue's seed_as: StopMoveStep initialises the hue and saturation transition states together, so it is declared on both and the engine sends it once per (endpoint, cluster, command).

defaults.bounds_note: raising fallback when the device exposes no bounds attribute; lowering ignores it

shadow_attributes.note: EnhancedColorMode tracks ColorMode: the mirror never writes enhanced-only modes, and values 0/2 are shared between the two

capabilities.note: RainMaker Neo HSV(1) <-> ColorMode CurrentHueAndSaturation(0); CCT(2) <-> ColorTemperatureMireds(2); inbound CurrentXAndCurrentY(1) folds to HSV via matter_aliases. No write_as: ColorMode has no setter command (CHIP switches it on color commands), so outbound uses the attribute-write fallback.

defaults.bounds_note: the enum members RainMaker defines (HSV=1, CCT=2); a derived dropdown needs the range the native firmware advertises

capabilities.note: Name <-> BasicInformation.NodeLabel (endpoint 0), bidirectional, truncated to 32 chars, bound only when the node has exactly one Matter-mapped device. A multi-device node has no node-level name: its per-device names stay cloud-side, matched to endpoints through the read-only FixedLabel entry each mirrored endpoint serves (rmng.device = device id, the correlation key). UserLabel is deliberately not a name sink: any controller on the fabric replaces the whole list, so an entry that changes or disappears cannot be read as user intent, and its 16-char cap would clip the name it wrote back.

Fan power through FanMode (a fan device has no OnOff cluster): Off<->0, On->4; every speed/auto mode reads back as on. FanMode is a writable attribute, so there is no write_as. rule_gated: only fan-family rules name this entry.
PercentSetting (writable attribute) as the RainMaker 0-5 speed; null while the device is in auto mode.
LocalTemperature in centi-degrees C; the plain temperature-sensor entry maps the TemperatureMeasurement cluster instead. rule_gated so only thermostat-family rules pull it.
SystemMode as the RainMaker AC mode vocabulary; EmergencyHeat folds to Heat, Sleep to Auto. Writable attribute.
CurrentPositionLiftPercent100ths; Matter's percent100ths convention is 0 = fully open, 10000 = fully closed, and the RainMaker position keeps that orientation.
LockState: rmng 0 = unlocked (also NotFullyLocked/Unlatched), 1 = locked. LockDoor/UnlockDoor are timed-interaction commands; the invoke shim handles the timed request.
IlluminanceMeasurement: lux = 10^((MeasuredValue - 1) / 10000), reported to 2 decimals; the spec's 0 (too low to measure) computes to ~1 lux through the same formula.
OccupancySensing.Occupancy bitmap; any set bit reports occupied (bool data_type renders non-zero as true).

CurrentMode; writes go through ChangeToMode (CurrentMode is read-only). Raising: labels and mode values come from SupportedModes. Lowering: SupportedModes comes from the param's valid_strs (Mode = index), a label with no mode_tags entry is dropped, and the param is not served when no label is left or the served tags miss a required_tags group.
RvcOperationalState.OperationalState: base states plus the RVC-specific ones.

LaundryWasherMode. Raising: labels and mode values come from SupportedModes. Lowering: SupportedModes comes from the param's valid_strs (Mode = index), a label with no mode_tags entry is dropped, and the param is not served when no label is left or the served tags miss a required_tags group.

composites.write_as_note: Controller-side command form: CurrentX/CurrentY are read-only, so a raising consumer drives color with MoveToColor; $value[i] is the i-th attribute value the conversion produced. Precedence: a param a scalar capability already reaches on the endpoint (hue/saturation when the light advertises HS, feature 0x01) uses that capability's own write_as (MoveToHue/MoveToSaturation); this composite binds, and this block applies, only to the params the scalar path could not reach (an XY-only light). The device (lowering) writes its own attributes and does not use this.
composites.note: CurrentX/CurrentY derived from hue+saturation (sRGB gamut, D65, gamma included; chromaticity only - brightness is LevelControl's). Lowered when all member params are bound on the endpoint; Extended Color Light (0x010D) mandates XY, which is why HS lights need this synthesis - Matter has no HS-only light device type. Inbound XY writes (MoveToColor lands as CurrentX/CurrentY updates) inject hue+saturation atomically (one write_params call). Outbound differs by side: the device (lowering) writes its own CurrentX/CurrentY attributes, so reports do not disturb ColorMode; a controller (raising) cannot write them (read-only) and uses write_as (MoveToColor).

rules.note: Extended Color Light: XY (mandatory) synthesized via the xy_from_hs composite, CT mandatory, HS optional-but-present. A hue/sat light WITHOUT cct falls through to 0x0101 (dimmable, color cloud-only): 0x010D mandates CT and 0x010C forbids HS, so Matter offers no valid target; CT synthesis from HS is a possible follow-up.

additional_device_types.note: Dimmable Plug-In Unit, the type 0x0110 is classified a superset of: declared alongside it so a controller that does not know the mounted types still renders the endpoint. Adds no clusters of its own - its mandatory set is already the matched rule's.

rules.note: Mounted Dimmable Load Control: a dimmer switch driving a load. The mounted control types are the server-side switch family; Matter's On/Off Switch (0x0103) and its dimmer/colour variants are client device types that originate commands over bindings, which an owned param cannot describe.

additional_device_types.note: On/Off Plug-in Unit, the type 0x010F is classified a superset of - see the 0x0110 rule.

rules.note: Mounted On/Off Control. Both mounted types mandate the OnOff Lighting feature and, when dimmable, LevelControl OnOff+Lighting - the same feature sets the light rules already build.
Dimmable Plug-In Unit; reuses the switch family's rule-gated dim entry.
Fan: power through FanMode, speed through PercentSetting; no OnOff cluster on the pure fan device type.
Setpoints are feature-gated (HEAT/COOL); a heat-only thermostat raises no cooling setpoint.
Room air conditioner: OnOff + Thermostat mandatory, FanControl optional (the speed entry matches when the cluster is present).
Smoke feature leads; a combined alarm also raises the CO state.

additional_device_types.note: pre-1.0 pump device type id, seen on early bridges

rules.note: Pump drives through its OnOff cluster; PumpConfigurationAndControl stays unmapped (diagnostics per spec section 4.5).

additional_device_types.note: legacy robotic vacuum device type id

rules.note: Event-only device: the Switch cluster has no state params to raise; the derived device carries events[] (representation-level for now).
